propositions: ~200 lines of production logic in reconcile-bridge-canary.yml run-blocks (staleness classification, alert-ticket lifecycle state machines) are untestable and unlintable; high-defect shell surface.

Classification and alert-lifecycle decision logic (api-error/stale/fresh classification, find/open/comment/close transitions) should migrate to scripts/canary_bridge.py with unit tests, while CAS push loops remain in YAML verbatim-tested.

The migrated module must preserve existing error handling dispositions per step: alert-write failures fail loud (non-zero exit), dedup-find failures degrade to empty, and rebar bridge-fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON indicates drift (not error).
DRY_RUN environment variable must be checked in both YAML step conditionals and within subcommand logic to prevent unintended rebar mutations.
Anti-rot tests must pin the canary wiring (workflow parses, steps invoke canonical Python entry points) and verify the CAS push loops remain byte-identical and tested.
